newsitem.title: INDIA: About 200 feared dead in India fire - news agency.
newsitem.headline: About 200 feared dead in India fire - news agency.

text.p: About 200 people were feared killed and several injured on Sunday when fire swept through temporary shelters at a religious conference in eastern India, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said some 5,000 people were attending the conference in Baripada town in Orissa state when the blaze tore through sheds erected for the three-day event.
Police chief A. B. Tripathy told PTI that rescuers were pulling bodies from under debris.
The agency said about 300 people with serious burn injuries had been admitted to a local hospital.
The fire set off a stampede among devotees at the Swami Nigamananda conference.
